# Introduction 

This RMarkdown reports the data preparation and analysis. It reports:

1. The estimate the use of primary care resources by the cohort of interest in terms of number of visits to relevant healthcare professional per person per year using the source dataset.
2. To estimate the cost of primary care in total and by relevant healthcare professional per person per year using the mapped dataset and compare results to the same analysis using the source dataset.

The scripts used in the data preparation and analysis have been adapted from the UCB Project.

# Data Preparations

We first clean the fractures, the project focused on the first fracture, by doing the following: 

1. Had their 1st $fx >= 01/04/2012$ and $<= 31/03/2018$ when they were $> 50$ years old
2. Excluding fracture happening before the birth year.
3. Excluding records that happen outside of study period.
4. Excluding records that happen outside of observation period.
5. Excluding trauma fractures (same day as trauma codes or 3 distinct fracture sites on the same date.
6. Excluding fractures on the same day as death or after death.
7. Clean out using washout period
8. Excluding records on the same day for the same person according to hierarchy (Hip, Spine, NHNS).

After cleaning the fractures, we then defined the cohort of interest.

9. Excluding not female individuals.
10. Excluding individuals without fracture records.
11. Excluding index fractures that happen on the last day of observation period.
12. Excluding records with insufficient prior observation and/or outside of observation period.
13. Excluding records of index fractures where the subject has not turned 50.
14. Excluding records happened after cancer.
15. Excluding records happened after metabolic bone diseases.

The attrition table is as shown below.

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(here)
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(rvest)
library(DT)
library(png)
library(grid)
```


```{r}
attrition_report <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_Raw.xlsx"))


attrition_report %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Attrition Report for Cleaning Fractures and Cohort**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2) 
```

# Results

## Table 1

NOTE: N to be fixed, I have reached out to the author of the `gtsummary` package.

The cohort defined had 25, 138 women who had their first fracture with an median at fracture occurrence at 71 years. Majority of women had the Non-Hip Non-Vertebra fracture (81\%), with the least women having had the vertebra fracture (5.2\%). 

```{r}
table1_data <- read_html(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "gt_summary_table_Raw.html")) %>% 
  html_node("table") %>%
  html_table()

table1_data %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 1(CPRD Source Data)**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2)

```

Out of the 25138 women, 24, 621(97.94\%) were service users. Service users were defined as women who attended clinically relevant consultation, see appendix for more information. While, 517 (2.06\%) were non-service users.  

```{r}
cohort_summary_raw_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "cohort_summary_raw.xlsx"))

cohort_summary_raw_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Cohort Summary Statistics**")
    # subtitle = md("*Subjects Who Visited a Clinically Relevant Consultant*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2) %>% 
  cols_label(
    num_distinct_women = "Number of Subjects",
    num_non_service_users = "Number of Non-services Users",
    perc_non_service_users = "Propotion of Non-services Users",
    num_service_users = "Number of Services Users",
    perc_service_users = "Propotion of Services Users"
  )
```


## Visits

The overall mean visits per year for service users was 16.13, while for all women irrespective of the service was 15.98.

```{r}
user_only_summary_statistics_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary_statistics")

user_only_summary_statistics_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**User Only Summary Statistics**"),
    subtitle = md("*Subjects Who Visited a Clinically Relevant Consultant*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 2) %>% 
  cols_label(
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean Visits Per Year",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum Visits Per Year",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum Visits Per Year",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD Visits Per Year",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median Visits Per Year",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile Visits Per Year",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile Visits Per Year"
  )
```

The figure below show the distribution of the visits per year for the women in our study. As shown in the plot majority of women as service users had visits between 1 and 100.

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
Plots_Total_Visits_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Plots_Total_Visits-Raw.PNG"))
grid.raster(Plots_Total_Visits_Raw)
```

The top 10 visited specialties by service users is shown in the boxplot below.

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
Users_Distribution_of_Visits_Top10_Specialties_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Users_Distribution_of_Visits_Top10_Specialties-Raw.PNG"))
grid.raster(Users_Distribution_of_Visits_Top10_Specialties_Raw)
```

# Appendix

Summary statistics of visits by specialty

```{r}
user_only_summary_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary")
```


```{r}
colnames(user_only_summary_rp) <- c("Specialty", "Total visits", "Mean visits per year", "SD visits per year", "Minimum visits per year", "Maximum visits per year", "Number of subjects")

# datatable(user_only_summary_rp,
#     rownames = FALSE, 
#     filter = 'top', 
#     options = list(
#         scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
#         search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
#         autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
#         columnDefs = list(
#           list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
#             list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
#             list(
#                 targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
#                 className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
#             )
#         )
#     )
# )

datatable(user_only_summary_rp,
    rownames = FALSE, 
    filter = 'top', 
    options = list(
        scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
        search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
        autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
        columnDefs = list(
          list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
            list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
            list(
                targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
                className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
            )
        ),
        initComplete = JS(
            "function(settings, json) {",
            "$(this.api().table().body()).css({'font-family': 'Times New Roman', 'font-size': '16px'});",
            "}"
        )
    )
)
```
